status: frozen for the official runs on the test split
tau_rule: lowest top Mapping score among correct dev answers, rounded down to a multiple of 0.05
notes: Mapping parameters unchanged from tune.py (12 combinations tie on dev; the one closest to the defaults is kept). Changing them would need new Verifier calls on dev without a dev signal.
With this tau no dev requirement is flagged low_confidence, so the dev results of P and P-V (R-34) stay valid.
Collector evidence in the loop comes from data/collected_v1 (0 LLM calls); run_pipeline.py is run with --no-new-collect.
